source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.why_hot: Copper is widely followed as an economic bellwether, and the sharp price rise has drawn attention from investors, manufacturers and analysts.
topics.share_angle: Explain what copper prices signal about global and Chinese economic activity, and how commodity swings affect consumers.

topics.chinese_topic: 数贸会一大批新技术新产品即将解锁
topics.official_english: Digital Trade Expo set to unveil new technologies and products
topics.why_hot: Digital trade is a major growth area, and the upcoming expo is seen as a window into China's latest tech and product innovations.
topics.share_angle: Introduce what a digital trade expo is and why new technology showcases matter for businesses and global digital trade.

topics.chinese_topic: 考研圈大地震！顶尖名校陆续停招学硕
topics.official_english: Top universities suspend academic master's programs amid graduate admission changes
topics.why_hot: The news directly affects current and prospective postgraduate applicants in China and has reignited debate about graduate education.
topics.share_angle: Explain the distinction between academic and professional master's degrees in China and what this shift could mean for students.

topics.chinese_topic: 华为、小米、苹果对决“万元机”
topics.official_english: Huawei, Xiaomi and Apple battle in the high-end '10,000-yuan' smartphone market
topics.why_hot: Smartphone consumers are closely comparing premium models from Chinese and global brands in an increasingly competitive high-end segment.
topics.share_angle: Break down how top phone makers are vying for the premium market in China and what features or services set them apart.

topics.chinese_topic: 今年下半年最强冷空气来袭
topics.official_english: China braces for the strongest cold snap of the second half of the year
topics.why_hot: A sharp temperature drop can affect daily life, travel, agriculture and heating preparation across large parts of China.
topics.share_angle: Explain how severe cold-air events are forecast and how Chinese cities usually respond to protect residents and infrastructure.

topics.official_english: Completed-home sales begin to take center stage in China's property market
topics.why_hot: As buyers worry about off-plan housing delivery, demand for ready-to-move-in homes is gaining more attention in China's property market.
topics.share_angle: Explain the difference between buying off-plan and completed homes, and why the shift matters for homebuyers and developers.

topics.chinese_topic: 物业回应禁止新能源车进地库：怕爆炸
topics.official_english: Property management explains ban on new-energy vehicles in underground garages over explosion concerns
topics.why_hot: The topic touches on electric-vehicle safety perceptions, residential property rules and consumer rights, generating wide public discussion.
topics.share_angle: Use the case to explore the balance between EV adoption, safety rules and community management in Chinese cities.

topics.chinese_topic: U20女足世界杯中国队5比0大胜
topics.official_english: China records 5-0 victory at the U-20 Women's World Cup
topics.why_hot: A dominant win by China's U-20 women's football team has excited fans and highlighted the country's next generation of women's players.
topics.share_angle: Highlight the result and explain why strong youth-team performances can shape the future of women's football in China.
